change: Ordinary Vulkan causal fused SDPA uses existing FullF32 cache/window metadata instead of Q*KV dense mask seed+cast. CPU and noncausal/wide/Sink/BF16 paths unchanged.
proof: For each valid q, position=KV-Q+q lies in[0,KV-1], so max(0,position-(KV-1))=0. Tile last query is clipped toQ-1, so last_key<=KV. Existing tensor-domain bounds make KV,window+1 and signed position safe. SplitKV keeps its own lower bound, only future tiles are clipped; cache offset remains0. Ordinary F32/F16 full-F32 path excludes quantized/MMQ branches.

space.oracle: Q/K all0, V nonzero.25; every524800 output scalar checked against analytic.25 with4e-6 absolute budget, both sides pass.
space.negative_control: Baseline expected to fail only new linear cold-backing upper bound (6402176>2099200). Raw GTest failure and process exit1 retained; candidate passes. Baseline constant output checks continue after nonfatal space assertion and pass.
space.limits: Native gallocr capacity is explicit owned backing, not whole/peak VRAM. Caller buffers separately counted. NativeWork internal flash split-K buffers, command/descriptors and driver/pool allocations remain separate/unknown; do not infer zero total scratch or total VRAM.

performance: No SDPA timing collected. Existing window=KV-1 semantics keeps left bound0 and clips wholly future causal tiles. This does not establish throughput parity or improvement.
cpu_deferred_reason: params.use_ref || boxed disables both tiled prefill and split-KV decode; row/head/batch work sharing remains. Losing tiled GEMM/KV reuse may regress large F32/F16 prefill. No multiplier measured. Native planner still reserves its bounded per-thread workspace. Boxed first/last only change eligible key rows; same vector dot/type conversions. F32/BF16 PV is F32. Existing unboxed F16 one-chunk uses Half VKQ accumulator; boxed switches this to F32, so cannot claim the old F16 private arithmetic is identical.
